about: D7: a positive dispatch for the alarm, note, trello and open kinds.

scenarios.why: The owner asks for an alarm; the host reads his own words and the alarm is set from the session's ask.
finals: Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning.

scenarios.why: The same ask kind answers a cancel, and the cancel path is the host's, not the model's.
finals: Cancel my alarm for tomorrow morning.

scenarios.why: A snooze is a write on the alarm the host already holds.
finals: Snooze that alarm for ten minutes.

scenarios.why: A save-cued note must stage the owner's own words. It stages locally, so the connector is never called; the model's reply is delivered on a later turn, which the corpus measures.
finals: Save a note: the synthetic bridge reopens on Monday.

args.title: Synthetic bridge
args.body: the synthetic bridge reopens on Monday

scenarios.why: A trello write is granted at the base, so the board service must receive the created card.
finals: Add a card to my Trello board called Synthetic card in Backlog.

scenarios.why: An owner-asked open is authorized and dispatched to the host's own open path; this lane binds no native open client, so the tool reports that it could not confirm the open.
